title: Longest Duplicate Substring
summary: Given a string, identify the longest substring that appears at least twice, including overlapping instances.
statement: Given a string, identify the longest substring that appears at least twice, including overlapping instances. If no such substring exists, return an empty string.
constraints: Return the lexicographically smallest among equally longest repeated substrings.
Overlapping occurrences are allowed; return empty when none repeats.
reference_solution:
def longest_duplicate_substring(s):
 def repeated(size):
  seen={};base=911382323;mod=2**61-1;power=pow(base,size,mod);value=0
  for char in s[:size]:value=(value*base+ord(char))%mod
  seen[value]=[0];found=[]
  for i in range(size,len(s)):
   value=(value*base+ord(s[i])-ord(s[i-size])*power)%mod;start=i-size+1
   for old in seen.get(value,[]):
    if s[old:old+size]==s[start:start+size]:found.append(s[start:start+size]);break
   seen.setdefault(value,[]).append(start)
  return min(found) if found else ''
 low,high=0,len(s);answer=''
 while low<high:
  middle=(low+high+1)//2;candidate=repeated(middle)
  if candidate:low=middle;answer=candidate
  else:high=middle-1
 return repeated(low) if low else ''
